title: Images to scan
description: Give image URLs, upload image files, or both. Each image becomes one dataset item.

imageUrls.title: Image URLs
imageUrls.description: Public http or https addresses of PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF images, up to 8 MiB each. A key-value store record address is read with the run's own access.

imageFiles.title: Image files
imageFiles.description: Upload images to a key-value store of your account, or give the address of a record that already holds one.

profile.title: Scan profile
profile.description: fast suits uploads and gives a reduced quality score. frame suits camera frames and gives no score. full searches deepest, which artistic QR codes need, and gives the full score.

budgetMs.title: Time budget per image (ms)
budgetMs.description: Stop the scan of one image after this many milliseconds. 0 means no budget. A cut scan is marked complete: false.
